method.coordinate_frame: Full unmasked coordinate raster, TIFF frame 0; separate from masked pilot model input.
method.inspection_scope: AI classification of scan/leaf boundaries and segment placement. Contact sheets are downsampled visual context, not full-resolution paleographic verification of every glyph or every line. Native details inspected for ambiguous cases.
method.candidate_geometry: Short edge boxes: full bbox within first 600 px or beginning after x=3300. Selection within visually established neighboring strips used bbox center <=350 (left) or >=3550 (right), width <=700, height >=32, with explicit image-based exclusions. Geometry alone was not accepted as proof.
limitations: No claim of exhaustive detection of every mixed main/neighbor box or unsegmented trace.
No new reading, reconstruction or translation; prior interpretations remain untouched.
Main-leaf marginalia, initials, diagram labels, ruling and damage are not automatically neighboring-leaf fragments.
No expert review or accuracy score.

excluded_specific_segments.reason: Continuation of the main-leaf line, before the physical gutter; native context inspected.
Paper damage/trace before the gutter, not established as writing on the neighboring leaf; native context inspected.
Very thin ruling/segmentation strip, not a usable text-line fragment; native context inspected.
Red annotation/line ending on the main leaf; detail contact sheet inspected.
Isolated trace before the gutter; not established as neighboring-leaf writing; detail contact sheet inspected.
Line ending on the main leaf; detail contact sheet inspected.
Line ending on the main leaf; detail contact sheet inspected.
Ink trace in the upper margin of the main leaf; detail contact sheet inspected.

additional_exclusions: Other edge candidates not in rows are left unchanged: main-leaf material, diagram, trace, or boundary not confirmed. This includes the diagram on 87r and ink marks on otherwise blank leaves.
